intro.titulo: How to use the EA family,
intro.texto: A real Claude Code session, sped up and in Spanish, on the president's office of Banco Andino S.A., a test organisation with synthetic material.

cierre.aviso: Real Claude Code recording, sped up. Banco Andino S.A. is a test organisation: the material is synthetic.

capitulos.texto: Two commands in Claude Code: the Criterio catalogue and the EA family. It installs Ofelia and Rostrum, the portal.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Ofelia, the president's office. From its documents she takes the entity, who she assists and the governing bodies —the board and the committee— and asks only what is missing.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: The terms are accepted with the name of whoever accepts. Here, a demo user.
What Ofelia found: 3 missing minutes, the oldest from 55 days ago, and a calendar exported 21 days ago, on which she does not calculate conflicts.

capitulos.titulo: The daily task, only with a yes
capitulos.texto: Ofelia proposes a daily task that reviews only what is due. Here it was left to run by hand.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: Ofelia is asked in natural language. She processes the sessions and the emails: 7 agreements without an owner and 6 emails past their deadline with no saved reply.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: The supervisor's request 45 is 26 days overdue. Ofelia does not write the draft: the reply commits the entity, and it belongs to a person.
